title: Erdős--Ko--Rado theorems in $\ell_2$-norm for three finite spaces
summary: Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a $k$-uniform hypergraph. The famous Erdős--Ko--Rado (1961) theorem determines the maximum size and extremal structure for $\mathcal{F}$ being $t$-intersecting, that is, $|F_1 \cap F_2| \ge t$ for any two edges $F_1, F_2$ of $\mathcal F$. The codegree squared sum $\mathrm{co}_2(\mathcal{F})$ is the square of the $\ell_2$-norm of the codegree vector of all $(k-1)$-sets in $\mathcal{F}$, which was initially introduced for Turán problems of hypergraphs.
